question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

Travelling from place to place
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'** i.e. **'Itinerant'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **phrase** "Travelling from place to place"** refers to **someone who moves around a lot, rather than staying in one place.
 
• The **most suitable word **that can substitute this phrase is: "Itinerant".
 
• **It describes** someone who travels from place to place, especially for work. (भ्रमण करने वाला)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Itinerant'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the other options:
 
 
• **"Recluse"** is a person who lives a solitary life and tends to avoid other people.(वैरागी)
 
• **"Arcane"** means understood by few; mysterious or secret.(गुप्त)
 
• **"Reverent" **means feeling or showing deep and solemn respect.(आदरपूर्ण)
